and data_source_id in
#{dataSourceId}

select * from ( select detail.batch_Id as batchId, detail.data_source_id as dataSourceId, coalesce(max(detail.data_name), detail.batch_Id) as taskName, case when max(source.data_source_access_way) = 'upload' then 'local' else 'system' end as taskType, max(source.data_source_name) as dataSourceName, sum(case when detail.status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as completedCount, count(1) as totalCount, max(source.create_user) as createUser, min(detail.create_time) as createTime, case when sum(case when detail.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then '1' when sum(case when detail.status = '-1' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then '-1' when min(detail.status) = '2' then '2' else '0' end as status from ins_data_source_desc detail left join ins_data_source source on source.id = detail.data_source_id where detail.batch_Id is not null and detail.batch_Id != '' group by detail.batch_Id, detail.data_source_id ) task
and task.taskName like concat('%', #{query.taskName}, '%')
and task.taskType = #{query.taskType}
and task.dataSourceName like concat('%', #{query.dataSourceName}, '%')
